---
title: "MIDSEA receives Funding Award extension"
date: 2026-04-02
categories: [Funding]
description: "Three additional years to build the regional modelling hub, including capacity grants for four new institutions."
---

We are pleased to announce that the MIDSEA network has received a three-year funding extension to continue building the regional modelling hub. The extended grant includes capacity-building grants for four new partner institutions across the region.
